story_id: STORY-078, STORY-080, STORY-082, STORY-083, STORY-085, STORY-086
description: No board draws how a user reaches Finance, Legal, Cap table or Data room. PG-A-Home shows Inbox, Activity and Personnel only, with no page rows and no glance values (runway, deadlines due, items waiting). The rule cards say 'Push from sidebar Finance row' but no sidebar board has such rows. Inner.png and Split.png also show no rows for them.
expected: A drawn entry point (row, glance badge or menu) on the outer Home and the inner sidebar for each of the four pages.
actual: Step 1 of every Finance/Legal/Cap table/Data room story has NO BOARD. The only route in is the agent row, which opens a chat, not the page.
suggested_fix: Add a Pages section (or glance row) to PG-A-Home and the inner sidebar showing the four pages with their glance values, and decide whether the agent row and page row both stay (see F-finance-settings-017).

criterion: Happy path clarity: error and blocked states
description: The Legal blocker ('Add your OpenRouter key') that replaces the page when no key exists is described only in the rule card. No board draws it, and no copy explains why an OpenRouter key specifically is required. Not-scanned-yet, scan failed, scan running and consent prompt states are also undrawn.
expected: Drawn blocked, never scanned, scan running and scan failed states on the Legal page, with one line of reason and a single action.
actual: PG-B-Legal draws only the healthy state (summary row, four contracts).
suggested_fix: Add a states strip to PG-B-Legal: blocker row, Not scanned yet with Scan now, scan in progress on the toolbar scan icon, failed warning row.

description: Cap table not-connected, connect pending, syncing, expired and error screens are described in the rule card but not drawn. The only drawn state is connected. The contact form (plus button) and holder detail on the outer display have no board.
expected: Not-connected screen with a single prominent Connect Carta action, then pending, then connected.
actual: Steps 1-5, 8-11 have NO BOARD. The plus button in the toolbar has no stated destination.
suggested_fix: Draw the not-connected and pending states and the contact form sheet; label the plus action (Add contact) in the rule card.

criterion: Information matches the story: Holders list
description: The 'Holders' list on PG-B-CapTable shows the same four categories as the ring legend (Founders, Option pool, Seed investors, Advisors) with counts, not individual holders such as 'Ana Ruiz, Common'. The legend with percents and the list with counts repeat the same four names directly above and below each other. DS-07 uses different labels (Founders, Investors, Pool, Other).
expected: Holder rows list people (initials avatar, name, class, share count, percent); the ring legend is the only place that names categories.
actual: Four category rows duplicate the legend; the story step 7-8 (tap Ana Ruiz for holder detail) cannot be done from this board.
suggested_fix: Replace the Holders rows with person rows (Ana Ruiz, Jordan Lee) as in the DS-07 Holder row, and align legend labels with DS-07.

description: Upload progress, search results, empty room, upload failed, file preview and folder contents have no outer-display board, and there is no way to select a Data room file to ask about it or to attach one in a composer. DS-07 specimens exist for upload rows but no page uses them.
expected: The upload row (progress, cancel), search results and folder push drawn on PG-B-DataRoom, plus a file action such as Ask about this file.
actual: Steps 3-6 of STORY-083 and steps 1-4 of STORY-084 rely on screens that are not drawn. 'Ask Data room agent' (bubble) opens a generic chat that does not carry the chosen file.
suggested_fix: Add states to PG-B-DataRoom: uploading, searching with result rows, empty. Add a long-press or row action 'Ask about this file' and a composer attachment source for Data room items (#417).

description: The outer Finance page titles the chart 'Monthly burn' with 12 unlabeled bars while the period tabs say 30 days, 90 days, 12 months. The Desk laptop board calls the same chart 'Monthly spend, Last 6 months' with month labels. The inner rule card lists sections 'Overview, Accounts, Burn, Spend' while the page shows Overview, Accounts, Upcoming. The 30 day tab with a monthly bar chart does not make sense.
expected: One chart name, one period model, bars labeled with months, section names that match across outer, inner and laptop.
actual: Burn vs spend, 12 bars vs 6 bars, Upcoming vs Spend; the highlighted bar on the outer board has no month label so step 4 ('Sep, AMOUNT') cannot be read.
suggested_fix: Pick 'Monthly burn' everywhere, add month labels as on Desk, state how each period tab changes the bars, and rename the rule-card sections to match.

description: Only Finance has a laptop-pose board, and Desk.dc.html shows the Finance agent thread on the bottom half, not the period tabs, accounts and Ask action that the rule card says go on the bottom half. Legal, Cap table and Data room inner (1/3 + 2/3), half-folded and laptop layouts exist only as rule-card text. No inner-display sidebar board shows rows for the four pages.
expected: Inner and laptop boards for each of the four pages, and a rule-card statement that matches the Desk board.
actual: Steps 7-14 of STORY-085 have NO BOARD; step 6 contradicts Desk (thread shown, not accounts).
suggested_fix: Add Inner and Desk boards for Legal, Cap table and Data room, and update the Finance laptop rule or the Desk board so they agree.

description: Hidden-amounts state is not drawn on PG-B-Finance (only as a DS-07 specimen), the chat finance card in the hidden state is not drawn, and the toggle exists only on the Finance page so a user who wants to mask before opening a thread has no control elsewhere. Home previews such as 'Balance as of this morning: [AMOUNT]' show amounts with no stated masking.
expected: Hidden state of the page and the chat card, and a decision on whether Hide amounts also masks Home previews, push text and Live Activities.
actual: Step 2 has NO BOARD; scope of masking unspecified.
suggested_fix: Draw the Finance page and the Finance chat card with amounts masked, and put a Hide amounts switch in Settings as well.

description: Settings opens with an X (xmark) in the side strip, but the story and catalog call the dismiss control 'Done'. The Home strip draws an 'AB' avatar button while the Settings profile row shows 'SR / Sam Rivera'. The story gap says the board has both a profile row and an Account row; the board has one profile row with the subtitle 'Account'. The Integrations count '[N]' is still a placeholder.
expected: One dismiss label, the same initials on Home and Settings, and a catalog that describes what is drawn.
actual: X vs Done, AB vs SR, two rows claimed vs one drawn.
suggested_fix: Make the Home avatar and Settings profile use the same initials, and correct the catalog text to say the X closes Settings and there is one profile row.

description: AI data sharing, Archived bots and Change password rows exist on PG-B-Settings but their pages are not drawn, and the in-thread consent prompt is not drawn. Account detail (sign out, delete account) and device-only preferences (Hide amounts, language, appearance, notifications) have no board.
expected: A page for each Settings row, and a consent prompt design reachable from a blocked run.
actual: STORY-094 and STORY-095 have NO BOARD for every step after the row tap; error text 'Review AI data sharing in Account settings' names a place that does not list it.
suggested_fix: Draw AI data sharing (switch per service, Withdraw all), Archived bots (list, empty, restore), Change password (form, mismatch error), and align the error wording with the row name.

description: The green 'Now using Model A.' success line is drawn under Default model in the resting state, before any change. The pickers for Model and Thinking are described as menus but not drawn. Backup models, embedding model and the disabled Thinking state are not designed.
expected: Success line appears only after a change; menu with a checkmark drawn once.
actual: The success line is always visible in the board and would read as permanent copy.
suggested_fix: Remove the line from the resting board, and draw a separate 'after choosing a model' state; add the Model and Thinking menus to DS-04 or the board.

description: Tapping a provider row leads to a detail page (API key field, show/hide, Connect, Replace, Disconnect) that is not drawn; the subscription sign-in page (code, Safari, wait) is not drawn; the list holds three rows only so a longer provider list has no design. The first-run route from 'Connect a model to start a run' to Models is also not drawn.
expected: Provider detail and subscription sign-in boards.
actual: Steps 2-4 have NO BOARD for the first-run goal of the whole app.
suggested_fix: Add provider detail (not connected, connecting, connected, error) and subscription sign-in boards; add a Connect action to the blocker message in the thread.

criterion: Nothing stated twice; state before action
description: On PG-B-Models, the Local server row shows 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1' and the Add a server field below shows the same URL as placeholder, with 'Found 3 models.' printed before any URL is entered or Find models tapped. 'Add a server' stays visible when a local server already exists. 127.0.0.1 on a phone is the phone itself, and the local-network permission is not designed. Advanced limits, found-model picker and manual model name have no board.
expected: Add a server shows an empty field in its resting state and a result line only after Find models; a real example address.
actual: Duplicate URL, result line shown in resting state, example that cannot work on device.
suggested_fix: Use an invented LAN address such as http://192.0.2.10:8000/v1 as the placeholder, and move the 'Found 3 models.' line into a separate state.

description: PG-B-Voice shows 'Use this device voice' on while 'Hosted voice' is Connected, so it is unclear which voice replies use; the story says turning the device voice off switches to hosted. The not-connected state (key field and Connect) is not drawn; the speech model picker and voice picker are not drawn. The prominent 'Hear a sample' is an icon-only play bubble with no visible label.
expected: A stated precedence (for example a single voice choice) and a drawn not-connected state; an accessible name 'Hear a sample' in the rule card.
actual: Two voices appear active at once; step 1 of STORY-092 has NO BOARD.
suggested_fix: Draw device-only and hosted-only states, state which wins when both are on, add the speech model picker and not-connected group.

description: Microphone and speech-recognition permission requests, the denied state, and voice AI data consent before the first hosted sample are not drawn. The Sounds section (Call sounds, Waiting sound) shows switches without saying what each does.
expected: Pre-permission and denied states; consent check before a hosted voice sample.
actual: A hosted sample with no consent fails with an error that points to 'Account settings'.
suggested_fix: Add a permission-denied row with an Open Settings action and route the consent check through the same prompt as F-finance-settings-010.

description: PG-B-Integrations draws Calendar as already 'Added', yet STORY-093 assumes it is not yet connected, so the Add, working and Safari-pending states for a catalog row are not drawn. App detail (accounts, tools, writes toggle, remove), the search field with results, Show more, and the connect-pending alert have no board. On the setup sheet the red error 'Could not verify or save these credentials' is shown before the user acts, the setup shows Project ID and API key for Composio while the story describes only a key, and 'Get credentials' is a full-width button that looks as strong as the checkmark that is the real prominent action.
expected: Error appears after Continue is tapped; one prominent action; fields match the provider.
actual: Error visible at rest; two strong buttons; field list differs from the story.
suggested_fix: Remove the red line from the resting sheet and draw it as a separate state; make Get credentials a text link; draw a Not added Calendar row, the pending state and the app detail page.

description: Finance, Legal and Cap table each exist as an agent row in Personnel (opens chat) and as a page. The Home board draws only the agent rows, so a user who taps 'Legal agent: 2 deadlines due this week' lands in chat and never sees the page. Each page toolbar also carries both a back chevron and an 'Ask agent' bubble that returns to the same agent.
expected: One way in per concept, or a clear difference between the chat and the page.
actual: Two entries for one concept with no drawn link between them.
suggested_fix: Decide that the agent row opens the chat and a page row or glance opens the page, and draw both once, with the page header linking to the chat.

description: The prominent bottom-left bubble on Finance, Legal, Cap table and Data room is a speech-bubble icon with no label, and it looks the same on all four pages although it opens four different agents. Toolbar groups show icon-only scan, plus, filter and refresh buttons whose meaning (plus = Add contact vs Add files) is not stated on the board.
expected: Rule card lists the accessible name for every icon, for example 'Ask Legal agent', 'Scan now', 'Add files'.
actual: Names are in the rule card text only for the bubble; plus, scan and filter are unnamed.
suggested_fix: Add an accessible-name line to each page card in PG-B-Rules.

description: On PG-B-Legal the amber scan icon in the summary row repeats the scan button in the toolbar, and '2 deadlines this week' summarizes what the Deadlines tab already shows. Contract rows show no chevron although the story expects a tap for detail, and the status words Signed, Awaiting and Expired are colored text dots rather than the DS-07 chips.
expected: One scan control, chevrons on tappable rows, status style from DS-07.
actual: Duplicated icon, no tap affordance.
suggested_fix: Remove the icon from the summary row, add chevrons to contract rows, and use the DS-07 status chip.

description: Upcoming rows on PG-B-Finance read 'Due Oct 24' for one row and 'Oct 31' for the next. The Runway and Cash figures use bracket placeholders, and no null runway, loading skeleton or error state is drawn.
expected: Same date wording in both rows; drawn loading, empty and error states.
actual: 'Due' prefix on one row only.
suggested_fix: Change 'Oct 31' to 'Due Oct 31' (or drop 'Due' from both).

description: The underlined 'Reconnect' link sits next to 'Carta is connected' while the connection is healthy, which offers a recovery action when nothing needs recovery.
expected: Reconnect appears only when the token has expired, or lives in a menu.
actual: Always visible.
suggested_fix: Remove the Reconnect link from the connected state; show it only in the expired state.

description: PG-B-DataRoom lists folders (Board materials, Diligence) under 'Recently added', mixing folders with files. DS-07 draws 'Shared / Only me / View only' chips while the plan says there are no share links, so the chips have no defined meaning.
expected: Folders in their own section; chips only if sharing exists.
actual: Mixed list; unexplained permission chips.
suggested_fix: Split into Folders and Recently added sections and drop the permission chips from DS-07 until sharing is planned.
